messages.content: What is the current Gini Coefficient of USA?

function.name: finance_fetchGDP
function.description: Fetch the GDP of the given country in the given year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

country.description: The name of the country to get the GDP of.

year.description: The year to get the GDP of.

format.description: The format to return the data in. Default is 'USD'.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have a real‑time data feed for inequality metrics. The most recent estimates that are publicly available come from international databases:

| Source | Year | Gini (US) |
|--------|------|-----------|
| World Bank (INEQUALITY – GINI index) | 2018 | **41.4** |
| OECD (Income Inequality – Gini Index) | 2019 | **0.421** |

These figures are expressed as a percentage (or decimal) where higher values indicate greater income inequality. If you need the absolute latest value, you would typically look at the most recent release from the World Bank’s “INEQUALITY” dataset or the OECD’s “Income Inequality” series.
